title: 234. Stone Game

examples.explanation: Alice starts first, and can only take the first 5 or the last 5. Say she takes the first 5, so the row becomes [3, 4, 5]. If Bob takes 3, then the board is [4, 5], and Alice takes 5 and then she wins (10 vs 7). If Bob takes the last 5, then the board is [3, 4], and Alice takes 4 and she wins (9 vs 8).

hints: Let dp[i][j] be the largest score advantage the current player can achieve on the subarray piles[i..j]. dp[i][j] = max(piles[i] - dp[i+1][j], piles[j] - dp[i][j-1]).
Alice wins if and only if dp[0][n-1] > 0. Solve dp over increasing interval lengths.
